messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: mvn build errors
parts:
Hi Kul,
I'm not seeing this, and i just double checked the build server and it seems to be ok too.
http://build.bedatadriven.com/job/renjin-0.7.0/27/

If you're invoking the test phase from the root, you may want to run mvn install to ensure that each module is running against the latest snapshots of the other modules.

Alex
